questions.question: When God restores Judah and Jerusalem, what does He say He will do with all the nations?

answers.text: Gather them down into one valley
Send them all home in peace

questions.question: In Joel's prophecy, God judges the nations in the Valley of Jehoshaphat. What is He judging them for?

answers.text: How they treated His people Israel
How they treated their own kings
How they ran their trade routes

questions.question: Why will God make the lands of Egypt and Edom desolate in the day of judgment?

answers.text: Because of their violence against Judah
Because they turned Judah's messengers away
Because their own rivers dried up

questions.question: In Joel's prophecy, while heaven and earth tremble, what will the LORD be for His people?

answers.text: A judge watching from far away
A voice they can no longer hear
